meta.title: Phase 0 — Monorepo Foundation + Design System
meta.blocks: ALL subsequent phases. No feature phase may start without gates passing.

intent.one-liner: Scaffold the pnpm + Turborepo monorepo and build @surte/design-system as a standalone React component library — independent of @surte/core — consumed by every package and app.
intent.why: Without a frozen monorepo scaffold and a real React component library, every feature phase will invent its own tokens, buttons, and spacing. This phase establishes the single source of truth for the entire visual and structural foundation of Surte.

stack.primitives: Radix UI headless (Dialog, Select, Slot, NavigationMenu, Label, AlertDialog)
stack.build: tsup 8.4.0 → ESM + CJS + .d.ts · "use client" banner automático
stack.quality: ESLint 9.17.0 · Prettier 3.4.2 + prettier-plugin-tailwindcss · commitlint · husky · lint-staged
stack.ci: GitHub Actions · Turborepo remote cache · size-limit · Lighthouse CI

package-architecture.rule: @surte/design-system tiene CERO dependencias de @surte/core. Puede importarse en cualquier package, app, o contexto externo.
Domain packages (products, stock, etc.) dependen de core + design-system.
apps/playground depende SOLO de @surte/design-system — es el Storybook del DS.
package-architecture.structure: inventory/ ├── package.json (workspaces, private:true, pnpm 9.15.4) ├── pnpm-workspace.yaml ├── turbo.json ├── tsconfig.base.json ├── .prettierrc ├── .editorconfig ├── commitlint.config.js ├── .gitignore ├── .npmrc │ ├── apps/ │ ├── wholesale/ (full — todos los packages) │ ├── bodega-simple/ (minimal — core + design-system + products) │ └── playground/ (Storybook 8 — SOLO @surte/design-system) │ └── packages/ ├── tsconfig/ @surte/tsconfig (base, react, lib) ├── design-system/ @surte/design-system ← construido en esta fase ├── core/ @surte/core ← fase posterior ├── auth/ @surte/auth ← fase posterior ├── products/ @surte/products ← fase posterior ├── stock/ @surte/stock ← fase posterior ├── expiration/ @surte/expiration ← fase posterior ├── sales/ @surte/sales ← fase posterior └── reports/ @surte/reports ← fase posterior

deliverables-part-1.name: Monorepo Root Config
deliverables-part-1.deliverable: Workspaces (apps/*, packages/*), scripts (dev, build, test, lint, typecheck, storybook), devDeps: turbo 2.3.3, typescript 5.7.3, eslint 9.17.0, prettier 3.4.2, changesets 2.27.9, husky 9.1.7, commitlint 19.6.1.

Pipeline: build (^build) · dev (^build, persistent) · typecheck (^build) · test (depende de typecheck) · lint (independiente) · storybook (^build, persistent) · size-limit (depende de build). ui: "tui" (Turborepo 2.x terminal UI).
Strict: noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noImplicitReturns, moduleResolution: Bundler.
semi:false, singleQuote:true, trailingComma:all, printWidth:100, plugins: [prettier-plugin-tailwindcss], tailwindFunctions: [cn, cva, clsx].
Conventional commits. Scopes: todos los packages + apps.

deliverables-part-2.name: packages/tsconfig/ — @surte/tsconfig
deliverables-part-2.deliverable: Extiende base. lib: [ES2022, DOM, DOM.Iterable], jsx: react-jsx. Para packages que usan React.
Extiende base. Sin DOM. emitDeclarationOnly: true. Para packages TS puros (core, domain, utils).

deliverables-part-3.name: packages/design-system/ — @surte/design-system
deliverables-part-3.deliverable: name: @surte/design-system, version: 0.1.0. exports: "." (ESM+CJS+types) + "./styles" (tokens.css). peerDeps: react ^18, react-dom ^18. deps: radix-ui, cva, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react. devDeps: tsup, tailwindcss, @surte/tsconfig.
Extiende @surte/tsconfig/react.
entry: src/index.ts. format: ESM + CJS. dts: true. clean: true. treeshake: true. banner "use client" (Next.js App Router compatibility). onSuccess: copia tokens.css → dist/tokens.css.

theme.extend con TODOS los tokens mapeados como referencias a CSS vars. colors (ink, terracotta, olive, semantic surfaces, text, brand, status), spacing (space-0..space-20), borderRadius (sm..pill), boxShadow (sm..focus), fontFamily (Manrope sans, JetBrains Mono mono), fontSize (xs..4xl), fontWeight (regular..extra), lineHeight (tight..relaxed), letterSpacing (tight..eyebrow), zIndex (base..toast), transitionDuration (fast/base/slow), transitionTimingFunction (ease-out/ease-in).

:root con ~80 CSS custom properties completas: brand anchors, ink scale (0..900), terracotta (50..900), olive (50..900, sparse), semantic surfaces, semantic text, semantic brand, status semaphore, typography vars, spacing (space-0..space-20), radius, shadows (carbon-tinted), motion, z-index, layout (sidebar-w, topbar-h, content-max, measure-prose). @import Google Fonts: Manrope + JetBrains Mono.
cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) = twMerge(clsx(inputs)).

Props: tokens (DesignTokenOverrides), mode (light|dark), scoped (boolean). Scoped=false → aplica CSS vars a document.documentElement. Scoped=true → aplica a wrapper div (para embedding en host pages). isSafeCSSValue guard — bloquea ; { } / * antes de setProperty. Exporta: ThemeProvider, useTheme, DesignTokenOverrides, ThemeMode.
TypeScript unions: ColorToken, SpaceToken, RadiusToken, ShadowToken, ZIndexToken, DurationToken. Autocomplete sin importar CSS.
Barrel export: cn, ThemeProvider + useTheme, los 12 componentes + sus tipos, token types.

cva variants: primary|secondary|ghost|danger × sizes: sm(36px)|md(44px)|lg(52px). States: default, hover, focus (terracotta ring), active, disabled, loading. Radix Slot (asChild pattern). Spec: components/C01_BUTTON.xml.
Types: text|number|integer|tel|email|date|search|textarea. Sizes: md(44px)|lg(52px). prefix-icon, suffix-unit, mono-numbers. States: hover, focus, error, disabled, readonly. Spec: C02_INPUT.xml.
Radix UI Select base. Variants: native|custom|searchable. Spec: C03_SELECT.xml.
Wrapper canónico: label + required(*) + hint + error + input slot. NUNCA usar inputs sin FormGroup. Spec: C04_FORM_GROUP.xml.
Variants: flat|bordered|elevated|warm|dark. Parts: CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, CardFooter. Spec: C05_CARD.xml.
Big number (JetBrains Mono) + label + delta opcional. Variants: default|investment|movement|profit|risk (Triángulo de Valor). Sizes: md(3xl)|lg(4xl). Spec: C06_KPI_CARD.xml.
Desktop: semantic table con thead/tbody. Mobile: reflow a list-card. States: sortable, loading, empty. Parts: t-mono, t-right, t-actions. Spec: C07_TABLE.xml.
cva variants: ok|caution|critical|info|neutral|dark × sizes: sm(22px)|md(28px). radius-pill. Máximo 3 palabras + Lucide icon opcional. Spec: C08_BADGE.xml.
Radix AlertDialog base. Variants: info|success|warning|danger. Estructura: icon(20px) + body(title+text) + dismiss opcional. role="alert" si dinámico. Spec: C09_ALERT.xml.

Radix Dialog base. Sizes: sm(440px)|md(560px)|lg(720px)|xl(960px). Focus trap, ESC close, backdrop click configurable, return focus. Parts: ModalHeader, ModalTitle, ModalDescription, ModalFooter. Spec: C10_MODAL.xml.

Dark surface (Carbon #1F2528), 272px fixed, sticky. Items 44px, radius-md, active = terracotta bg. Responsive: sidebar → drawer trigger en mobile (<1024px). Parts: SidebarNavItem, SidebarNavGroup. Spec: C11_SIDEBAR_NAV.xml.

Variants: first-use|no-results|error. icon(80px, terracotta-50 bg) + title(text-xl) + body + CTA primary + secondary opcional. Copy en 2ª persona informal. NUNCA estado vacío ciego. Spec: C12_EMPTY_STATE.xml.

deliverables-part-4.name: apps/playground/ — Storybook 8
deliverables-part-4.deliverable: framework: @storybook/react-vite. addons: addon-a11y, addon-docs, addon-viewport. stories: ["../../packages/design-system/src/**/*.stories.tsx"].
deliverables-part-4.rule: Un story por componente (*.stories.tsx co-located en packages/design-system/src/components/).
Cada story muestra: todas las variantes, todos los sizes, todos los estados.

build-order.step: Crear package.json + pnpm-workspace.yaml + turbo.json + tsconfig.base.json + .prettierrc + .editorconfig + commitlint.config.js + .gitignore + .npmrc.
Crear packages/tsconfig/ con package.json + base.json + react.json + lib.json.
Crear packages/design-system/src/tokens.css con todos los CSS custom properties. Leer TOKENS.xml como referencia. Verificar gate G0-T1..T5.

Crear los 12 componentes en src/components/*.tsx. Leer components/C01..C12.xml como spec de cada uno. Orden: Button → Input → Select → FormGroup → Card → KpiCard → Table → Badge → Alert → Modal → SidebarNav → EmptyState.
Crear *.stories.tsx co-located con cada componente. Un story por variante + un story de "all variants" para review rápido.
Crear src/index.ts con todos los exports.
pnpm install → pnpm typecheck → pnpm build → pnpm storybook. Correr gates G0-*. Todos deben pasar antes de marcar fase completa.

gate-category.name: install
gate-category.gate: pnpm install termina limpio (0 errores, 0 peer dep warnings críticos).
pnpm -r typecheck pasa con 0 errores en todos los packages.
pnpm -r build pasa. dist/ generado en packages/design-system/ y packages/tsconfig/.

gate-category.name: tokens
gate-category.gate: tokens.css expone las 6 brand colors como nombres semánticos bajo :root.
Escala ink-0..900 (12 pasos) + terracotta-50..900 (10 pasos) + olive sparse presentes.
Spacing usa SOLO múltiplos de 4. space-1=4px, space-2=8px confirmados.
Radius: sm(4px) md(8px) lg(12px) xl(16px) 2xl(24px) pill(999px).
Shadows tintadas con rgba(31,37,40,α). Cero rgb(0,0,0) en shadows.
tailwind.config.ts referencia los tokens SOLO via var(--*). Cero hex hardcoded.

gate-category.name: design-system
gate-category.gate: @surte/design-system exporta los 12 componentes desde src/index.ts.
dist/tokens.css existe y es importable via @surte/design-system/styles.
ThemeProvider acepta tokens override + funciona en modo scoped y global.
cn() resuelve conflictos de clases Tailwind correctamente (twMerge).
Cero !important. Cero magic numbers en componentes — todo via tokens.
@surte/design-system NO importa @surte/core ni ningún otro @surte/* package.

gate-category.name: visual
gate-category.gate: Carbon/Linen contraste ≥ 11:1 (WCAG AA pass).
Terracotta/White contraste ≥ 4.5:1 (WCAG AA pass).
Font families: SOLO Manrope (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono). Nada más.
Iconos: SOLO lucide-react, stroke 1.75px. Cero SVGs inline ad-hoc.
Focus ring: 2px terracotta + 2px offset en todos los elementos focusables.
Hit targets ≥ 44px en mobile (Button md, Input md, SidebarNavItem).

gate-category.name: storybook
gate-category.gate: pnpm storybook arranca sin errores. URL accesible en localhost.
Los 12 componentes tienen story. Todas las variantes visibles.
addon-a11y no reporta violations en ningún story.
Viewports 375px y 1440px funcionan en Storybook viewport switcher.

gate-category.name: bundle
gate-category.gate: dist/index.js (ESM) ≤ 60kb gzip (sin contar peer deps: react, radix).
Tree-shaking funciona: import { Button } from @surte/design-system no arrastra Table ni Modal.

consumer-rules.rule: Importar tokens.css via @surte/design-system/styles en el root layout de cada app.
Usar ThemeProvider en el root layout. Sin ThemeProvider, los tokens no se aplican.
JAMÁS usar hex literales o px hardcoded en feature code — siempre var(--*) o clases Tailwind del preset.
JAMÁS sobreescribir estilos base de un componente desde un feature package.
Componente nuevo requiere: spec XML en PHASE_0/components/ + decisión DS-NNN + story en playground.
Variantes ad-hoc prohibidas. Si un caso no está cubierto, se discute antes de codear.
